snippet.title: Dark Alley - Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
#steam #steamdeck 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4354830?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=announcement&utm_medium=youtube

A narrative noir thriller set in Kyoto. Detective Thomas Bennett investigates the disappearance of a British agent, only to collide with the Yakuza, a shadowy conspiracy, and a truth that should never surface.

Dark Alley is a standalone case within the Detective Bennett: Solved Cases saga, a cinematic narrative thriller with psychological tension and dry, noir humor.

Kyoto, 2013. A British detective vanishes without a trace. London sends Thomas Bennett to close the case quietly. But Kyoto doesn’t do “quiet.” Beneath red lanterns and rain-slicked alleys, Bennett finds a city built on rituals, secrets… and people willing to kill to protect them.

What starts as a missing-person investigation spirals into a dangerous web involving the Dragon Vein Yakuza, a mysterious informant, and a cold institutional presence that watches every step Bennett takes. The deeper you go through nightclubs, temples, bamboo forests and mirrored corridors, the more mystery arise around the case… until the question isn’t who took Hale, but why the truth was never meant to survive.

Features
- A focused narrative experience designed to be played from start to end, no filler, no grind, just the case.
- Noir investigation in modern Kyoto: Explore Gion’s red-lantern alleys, Nishiki Market area, a secret onsen nightclub, abandoned temples and bamboo trails.
- Cinematic storytelling with Bennett’s signature voice: Internal monologue, sharp dialogue, and a protagonist who masks fear with sarcasm, until the case breaks through.

- Evidence-driven gameplay: Inspect scenes, collect clues, use your notebook to document evidence, reconstruct events, and unlock new leads without getting stuck.

- A city of factions and shadows: Cross paths with allies and enemies: Hiroshi Tanaka, the Yakuza leader Katsuro, and a mysterious man behind a black car.

- Part of the Detective Bennett universe:Dark Alley is a key chapter that shapes Bennett into the man you’ll meet later in The Empty Desk.
